scope: Phase 3 slice 1: participant-only chat, conversation list, unmatch, block/unblock
checks: participant-only send and read; non-participants receive 404
conversation list with partner, timestamp and last-message preview
unmatch closes chat, is idempotent and is audited
block closes match/chat, blocks sends (403) and is audited; unblock is idempotent
protected /messages pages redirect unauthenticated visitors to /login
